annotations.title: Show the sessions in the person's My day

description: The sessions the signed-in person saved to My day for one event ("what is in my day", "my saved sessions"), earliest first. Each row carries the title, `whenLocal` (the spoken local time), the room, its speakers, and `ended` (true once the session is over). The reply also carries `myDayUrl`, which opens My day on the event page. It is the same list the pass page and the event page show: a session saved there is here, and the reverse. Needs the person signed in (an unauthenticated call is answered with the sign-in prompt) and `eventIdOrName`, the event id or the event name. An empty `sessions` means nothing is saved for that event yet; event_my_day_change adds one.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event name as events_list spells it.
